title: Towards Human-Machine Friendly Learning-Based Video Coding
organization: Beijing Key Laboratory of Advanced Information Science and Network Technology
points: Devised semantic-controlled VSR that combines patch-level blurring and residual shift in diffusion process and determines conditions by the instance-centric and channel-wise semantics within and across clips during generation, enhancing content realism and temporal coherence.

Proposed semantic-guided inter-frame alignment that decouples video into instance, event and scene and conducts semantic-guided instance-centric alignment among adjacent frames, gaining better performance when facing with large motion amplitude and background change.
Designed motion-driven temporal gate and texture-condition spatial gate based on the characteristic of residual coding, balancing the bit allocation within video compression along the temporal axis.

title: Enhancement and Cognition of Video Content in Complex Scenes
organization: Visual Intelligence + X International Cooperation Joint Laboratory of MOE
fund: National Natural Science Foundation of China
points: Exploring the inherent capability of Multi-Modal Large Model to perceive semantic information and degradation for the sake of dealing with complex and unknown deterioration of video captured in real world via LoRA, etc.

title:

fund:
